entry.name: jit.ui.canvas
entry.digest: A canvas to render jit.ui objects
entry.description: Every jit.ui object needs the canvas attribute set to a jit.ui.canvas name. There can be more than a single jit.ui.canvas per rendering context.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background_color
attributes.digest: Color of main body of the UI object (default = 0.7 0.7 0.7 1.)
attributes.description: Color of main body of the UI object (default = 0.7 0.7 0.7 1.)

attributes.name: border
attributes.digest: Enable border around the UI object (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enable border around the UI object (default = 1)

attributes.name: border_color
attributes.digest: Color of border around the UI object (default = 0. 0. 0. 1.)
attributes.description: Color of border around the UI object (default = 0. 0. 0. 1.)

attributes.name: border_size
attributes.digest: Size of border around the UI object in pixels
attributes.description: Size of border around the UI object in pixels

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: constant_pixel_size
attributes.digest: Maintain consistent pixel size regardless of rendering window size (default = 1)
attributes.description: Maintain consistent pixel size regardless of rendering window size (default = 1).When enabled, the UI object retains its pixel dimensions even if the rendering window is resized.

attributes.name: drawto
attributes.digest: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none)
attributes.description: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none)A named drawing context is a named instance of a jit.window, jit.pwindow, or jit.matrix object that has an instance of the jit.gl.render object associated with it.

attributes.name: edit_mode
attributes.digest: Manually set edit or lock mode for contained UI objects (default = 0)
attributes.description: Manually set edit or lock mode for contained UI objects (default = 0)By default edit and lock mode is set with the unlocking and locking of the patcher.This flag allows to manually set edit or lock mode, until the lock status of the patcher is changed.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.digest: Enable flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enable flag (default = 1)When the flag is set, drawing is enabled.

attributes.name: enable_label
attributes.digest: Enable label text (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enable label text (default = 1)When the flag is set, the label text is shown.

attributes.name: enable_mouse_editing
attributes.digest: Enable mouse editing (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enable mouse editing (default = 1)When enabled and the patch is unlocked, the UI object can be resized and moved with the mouse.

attributes.name: font
attributes.digest: Font name
attributes.description: Font name

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Font size
attributes.description: Font size

attributes.name: grid_cell_size
attributes.digest: Size in pixels of the grid cells (default = 100 100)
attributes.description: Size in pixels of the grid cells (default = 100 100)Set the attributeto 1 to visualize the canvas grid.

attributes.name: grid_offset
attributes.digest: Offset in pixels of the grid (default = 0 0)
attributes.description: Offset in pixels of the grid (default = 0 0)

attributes.name: group
attributes.digest: Name of assignedobject
attributes.description: Name of assignedobjectWhen set, this UI object will be assigned to that

attributes.name: height
attributes.digest: Height of the UI object in pixels
attributes.description: Height of the UI object in pixels

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hide_background
attributes.digest: Hide UI object background (default = 0)
attributes.description: Hide UI object background (default = 0)

attributes.name: highlight_color
attributes.digest: Background color when the mouse hovers on the UI object (default = 0.9 0.9 0.9 1)
attributes.description: Background color when the mouse hovers on the UI object (default = 0.9 0.9 0.9 1)

attributes.name: highlight_hover
attributes.digest: Enable highlight on hover (default = 0)
attributes.description: Enable highlight on hover (default = 0)When enabled and the mouse is on top of the UI object area, the background changes to the.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignore_click
attributes.digest: Ignore mouse clicks (default = 0)
attributes.description: Ignore mouse clicks (default = 0)When set to 1, the UI object will not respond to mouse clicks unless in edit mode.

attributes.name: ignore_patch_lock
attributes.digest: Ignore patch lock status (default = 0)
attributes.description: Ignore patch lock status (default = 0)When the flag is set,will decouple the lock status of the patch from jit.ui edit / lock mode.To go into edit or lock mode you can then use theattribute.

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: keep_in_window
attributes.digest: Prevent the UI object from moving outside the rendering window (default = 1)
attributes.description: Prevent the UI object from moving outside the rendering window (default = 1).

attributes.name: label
attributes.digest: UI object label text
attributes.description: UI object label text

attributes.name: label_align
attributes.digest: Text alignment mode (default = 1 (center))
attributes.description: Text alignment mode (default = 1 (center))

attributes.name: label_bold
attributes.digest: Label text bold style (default = 1)
attributes.description: Label text bold style (default = 1)

attributes.name: label_color
attributes.digest: Label text color (default = 1. 1. 1. 1.)
attributes.description: Label text color (default = 1. 1. 1. 1.)

attributes.name: label_offset
attributes.digest: Label text offset in pixels from center of UI object
attributes.description: Label text offset in pixels from center of UI object

attributes.name: layer
attributes.digest: UI Object layer number (default = 0)
attributes.description: UI Object layer number (default = 0)

attributes.name: name
attributes.digest: Name of the
attributes.description: Name of theIf this attribute is not set, the canvas will automatically receive a unique name.The name of this canvas must be set as the value for theattribute of jit.ui objects that should draw to this canvas.

attributes.name: order_in_group
attributes.digest: Order index within a UI group when theattribute is set
attributes.description: Order index within a UI group when theattribute is set.

attributes.name: output_texture
attributes.digest: Capture to internal texture (default = 0)
attributes.description: Capture to the internal texture (default = 0)When enabled, all rendering is captured to texture and the texture name is output out the left outlet.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: UI object position in pixels
attributes.description: UI object position in pixelsThe position of the UI object is constant in relation to the position of its anchor.

attributes.name: position_anchor
attributes.digest: UI object anchor position in pixels
attributes.description: UI object anchor position in pixelsThe position of the UI object is always constant in relation to its anchor position. When the rendering window is resized, the anchor maintains the same position, proportion-wise, inside the rendering window, while the UI object follows its anchor.

attributes.name: position_anchor_percentage
attributes.digest: UI object anchor position as a percentage of the rendering window size (default = 50 50)
attributes.description: UI object anchor position as a percentage of the rendering window size (default = 50 50)Sets the anchor position of the UI object as a percentage of the rendering window dimensions. The UI object maintains its position relative to this anchor when the window is resized.

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: read_image_background
attributes.digest: Load an image and display it on the background of the UI object
attributes.description: Load an image and display it on the background of the UI objectThe argument to this attribute is the path of the image.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: roundness_corners
attributes.digest: Roundness of corners of the UI object (default = 0.2)
attributes.description: Roundness of corners of the UI object (default = 0.2)

attributes.name: scale
attributes.digest: Uniform scale of the UI object as a single scalar number (default = 1)
attributes.description: Uniform scale of the UI object as a single scalar number (default = 1)

attributes.name: shadow
attributes.digest: Enable shadow flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enable shadow flag (default = 1)

attributes.name: shadow_color
attributes.digest: Color of the shadow (default = 0.1 0.1 0.1 0.5)
attributes.description: Color of the shadow (default = 0.1 0.1 0.1 0.5)

attributes.name: shadow_offset
attributes.digest: Shadow offset in pixels from center of object
attributes.description: Shadow offset in pixels from center of object

attributes.name: show_grid
attributes.digest: Show grid flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: Show grid flag (default = 0)When the flag is set, a 2D grid will appear in the rendering window.The position and corners of jit.ui objects can be snapped to the grid intersections by pressing "ctrl" or "cmd" and dragging with the mouse.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: take_row_group
attributes.digest: Occupy a full row within a UI group (default = 0)
attributes.description: Occupy a full row within a UI group (default = 0)

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: texture_background

attributes.description: Name of texture to be applied to background of the UI object (default = none)

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Width of the UI object in pixels
attributes.description: Width of the UI object in pixels
